answer: The sparrow schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the falcon checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. Someone wanting 107 effective identities must lock that capital for 50 epochs and keep it locked through every yarrow audit. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 50 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. That is 3 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
